sources.title: Goldman Sachs: Generative AI Could Replace 300 Million Jobs
sources.excerpt: March 29, 2023 - Goldman Sachs economists believe generative AI could replace up to one-fourth

reasoning: The claim distorts the findings of a widely cited March 2023 report by Goldman Sachs economists. The report estimated that generative AI could *expose* the equivalent of up to 300 million full-time jobs worldwide to automation, rather than definitively predicting that 300 million jobs "will be replaced." Crucially, the authors noted that for the vast majority of occupations, automation would only affect a fraction of tasks, meaning AI is far more likely to complement workers and enhance productivity than outright eliminate their roles. Furthermore, the report projected that technological displacement would historically be offset by the creation of new employment opportunities and significant economic growth. Presenting an upper-bound scenario of automation exposure as an inevitable total loss of 300 million jobs is misleading.
